beats.narration_slice: A barreleye fish wears a transparent dome over its head.
beats.visual: Vertical monochrome line-art close-up of a barreleye fish drifting in open deep water, its transparent cranial dome outlined with a single restrained cyan accent so the structure reads instantly.
beats.purpose: show the barreleye fish's transparent dome over its head
beats.visual_fingerprint: barreleye fish + stationary side-profile drift + extreme close-up + empty midwater zone + transparent dome as cyan anatomical reveal + fish placed high-center with broad negative space below
beats.continuity: Begins the creature sequence in a clean deep-ocean subject world with the shared off-white paper field and sparse particulate marks.

beats.narration_slice: Its tubular eyes rotate upward to watch for prey above.
beats.visual: Technical-drawing-style cutaway of the barreleye seen from a three-quarter underside angle, with paired tubular eyes visibly pivoted upward toward a tiny prey silhouette overhead.
beats.purpose: explain that the barreleye's tubular eyes rotate upward to watch for prey
beats.visual_fingerprint: barreleye eye anatomy + eyes pivot upward toward prey + medium three-quarter underside view + upper-water prey zone + curved motion cues around tubular eyes + strong diagonal composition from fish lower-left to prey upper-right
beats.continuity: Stays with the barreleye but changes from exterior portrait to anatomical action and an upward-looking composition.

beats.narration_slice: A goblin shark shoots its jaws forward to snatch prey.
beats.visual: Side-on line illustration of a goblin shark lunging horizontally as its jaws project far ahead of its snout toward a small fish, with sparse current lines emphasizing the sudden strike.
beats.purpose: show the goblin shark's protrusible jaws shooting forward to catch prey
beats.visual_fingerprint: goblin shark + explosive jaw projection + wide side view + open hunting corridor + prey directly ahead + long horizontal composition dominated by extended jaws and speed lines
beats.continuity: Moves from a quiet upward-looking sensory adaptation to a fast horizontal feeding action by a different animal.

beats.narration_slice: A vampire squid flips its webbed arms outward, revealing tiny spines.
beats.visual: Front-facing vampire squid suspended against sparse deep-water marks, arms flipped outward into a broad circular web with tiny spine-like cirri picked out around the inner surface.
beats.purpose: show the vampire squid exposing its webbing and tiny spines
beats.visual_fingerprint: vampire squid + arms inverted outward + frontal medium shot + isolated blackwater pocket + tiny cirri as anatomical detail + radial flower-like silhouette centered in frame
beats.continuity: Contrasts the shark's lateral strike with a centered defensive reveal that expands radially toward the viewer.

beats.narration_slice: A leafy seadragon disappears among seaweed with leaflike camouflage.
beats.visual: Tall seaweed thicket drawn in loose monoline contours with a leafy seadragon woven vertically through the fronds, its appendages deliberately echoing surrounding blades so its outline is initially hard to separate.
beats.purpose: show how the leafy seadragon blends into seaweed using leaflike camouflage
beats.visual_fingerprint: leafy seadragon + hovering motionless among swaying vegetation + full-body environmental shot + dense seaweed garden + matching leaf-shaped appendages + asymmetrical vertical camouflage composition with subject offset right
beats.continuity: Leaves isolated open water for a textured vegetation zone where the adaptation works through concealment instead of display.

beats.narration_slice: A giant isopod looks like an armored pill bug.
beats.visual: Low-angle illustration of a giant isopod crawling across the seafloor, its overlapping segmented plates emphasized, while the Red Horned Everyman crouches at a respectful distance studying its pill-bug-like armor.
beats.purpose: make the giant isopod's pill-bug-like segmented armor immediately recognizable
beats.visual_fingerprint: giant isopod with Red Horned Everyman + slow seafloor crawl and skeptical observation + low-angle wide shot + rocky benthic floor + repeated armored body plates + isopod dominating foreground while small host anchors rear-left scale
beats.continuity: Drops from the seaweed column to the seafloor and briefly introduces the in-world host as a grounded scale and observation cue.

beats.narration_slice: A Dumbo octopus flaps ear-like fins through the deep.
beats.visual: Small Dumbo octopus shown from a high three-quarter view gliding through a broad empty water column, with its paired ear-like fins caught at opposite points of a gentle flap.
beats.purpose: show the Dumbo octopus swimming by flapping its ear-like fins
beats.visual_fingerprint: Dumbo octopus + gentle paired-fin flapping + distant high-angle full-body shot + vast open-water column + curved fin-motion marks + tiny subject low-center surrounded by generous negative space
beats.continuity: Leaves the grounded seafloor and host behind, opening into a spacious midwater composition focused on gentle locomotion.

beats.narration_slice: An anglerfish dangles a glowing lure in darkness.
beats.visual: Anglerfish emerging from a nearly empty off-white-to-graphite implied abyss, shown in side three-quarter close-up with a tiny cyan bioluminescent lure hanging above its mouth and attracting a small prey silhouette.
beats.purpose: show the anglerfish using a glowing lure in dark water
beats.visual_fingerprint: anglerfish + lure dangling toward prey + tight three-quarter close-up + sparse abyssal darkness zone + single cyan bioluminescent bulb + face anchored lower-right with lure arcing into empty upper-left
beats.continuity: Turns the previous airy swimming scene into a tighter darkness-focused hunting scene, using the world's rare cyan accent for bioluminescence.

beats.narration_slice: A blanket octopus unfurls a huge web between its arms.
beats.visual: Wide vertical illustration of a blanket octopus sweeping upward through open water as an enormous webbed membrane unfurls behind and between its arms like a flowing biological sail.
beats.purpose: show the blanket octopus spreading its unusually large arm membrane
beats.visual_fingerprint: blanket octopus + membrane dramatically unfurling + full-body upward wide shot + open pelagic zone with sparse currents + enormous flowing web as key adaptation + sweeping S-curve composition filling the upper two-thirds
beats.continuity: Expands from the anglerfish's tight dark close-up into a broad final silhouette reveal, ending the body sequence with the largest flowing shape.
